method: Prior evidence retained with original dates; targeted official pages rechecked 2026-10-30 for V2. Research reread documented in RESEARCH-COVERAGE.json. No fresh video viewing or current-price survey claimed.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Simplify forms: eliminate, automate, simplify
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: NN/g recommends removing unnecessary questions before automating and simplifying remaining input.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Use as design guidance; actual W&M task completion must be observed.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Cloudflare Workers pricing
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: Workers Paid has a $5 monthly subscription with included usage and metered overages.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Platform subscription is not the full operating cost; existing billing may reduce incremental cost.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Cloudflare D1 limits
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: Paid databases have a 10 GB per-database limit and 30-day Time Travel; Free has 500 MB per database and seven-day Time Travel.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Recovery windows do not replace independent exports or object backups.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Cloudflare D1 pricing
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: D1 meters rows read, rows written and storage, with included plan allowances.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Index design affects scanned rows; avoid treating the service as unlimited.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Cloudflare Queues delivery
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: Queues uses at-least-once delivery and can deliver a message more than once.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Application-level deduplication and provider reconciliation are still needed.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Cloudflare Workflows rules
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: Workflow steps are individually retryable; documentation recommends idempotent external operations.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: A workflow engine does not make an arbitrary external action exactly-once.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Supabase pricing
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: Pro starts at $25/month; first project included; paid usage and additional projects can increase the total. Free projects can pause after inactivity.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Verify compute, storage, egress and add-ons for the selected account before purchase.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Supabase row-level security
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: RLS can constrain record access; privileged service access and some views/functions can bypass policies.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Managed infrastructure is not a substitute for tested tenant authorization.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Supabase production auth email
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: The default mailer is restricted to project team addresses and currently two messages/hour; production delivery needs custom SMTP.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Configure and test real recipient delivery, rate limits and account recovery.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Email link prefetching
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: Security scanners can consume one-time links. Supabase documents OTP and an intermediate confirmation page as mitigations.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Also test task return, expired links and disabled email link tracking.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Database backups exclude file bytes
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: Pro retains seven days of daily database backups; Storage object bytes are not included in database backups.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Back up and restore files separately and reconcile them with database metadata.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Resend inbound message content
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: Received-email webhooks provide metadata; body, headers and attachments require subsequent API retrieval.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Durably accept the receipt before asynchronous retrieval and handle retrieval failure visibly.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Resend attachment retrieval
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: Attachment download URLs are valid for one hour and can be refreshed through the API.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Copy accepted file bytes to private application storage; do not make temporary URLs the permanent attachment record.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Resend idempotency window
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: Resend retains idempotency keys for 24 hours.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Keep a durable local operation ledger; reconcile late/unknown sends rather than relying forever on provider deduplication.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Stripe webhook behavior
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: Stripe documents signature validation, duplicate deliveries and non-guaranteed event order. Current provider objects can resolve missing or stale events.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: A duplicate event differs from a genuine second charge; do not collapse distinct financial transactions.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: ManyRequests email intake rules
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: Known-client matching is required; some ineligible senders are ignored without notification. Service selection follows a documented order, and attachments over 25 MB are skipped.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: A concrete fit gap to test, not proof the whole product is unsuitable. Current vendor behavior can change.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: ManyRequests pricing
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: Monthly Core is $59 and Pro $99, each with one internal seat. Core includes requests/proofing; Pro lists webhooks and more notification controls.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Additional seats, annual terms, integration costs and payment fees need a real quote.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Assembly multi-company clients
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: Professional and above supports one login switching between assigned companies; the article describes up to 30 companies per client.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Verify current plan/limits and isolation with actual tasks; this does not prove every approval requirement.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Assembly plan selection
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: Dot found API/custom-domain/automation and audit/access features at different plan tiers; dynamic numeric prices were not reliably readable.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Exact cost is deliberately unresolved. Confirm required features and current monthly quote before selecting.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Wayfront pricing (SPP successor route)
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: Base lists $129 monthly/$99 annual-equivalent; Pro $299/$249. Client coworkers are listed on Pro; integration API is an add-on choice.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Verify checkout terms and API cost. Coworkers do not by themselves prove unrelated multi-business switching.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Clerk managed-auth cost
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: Pro is $25 monthly or $20/month billed annually; organization features and usage can add cost.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Identity service plans do not enforce application D1 record permissions.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Structured AI output still needs validation
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: Structured Outputs can still contain mistakes despite meeting a schema.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Validate facts and authority separately; a schema is not proof of a correct business decision.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: AI tools and review gates
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: The documentation demonstrates explicit review before a tool action executes.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: The W&M design additionally enforces application permissions and state checks; prompts alone are not controls.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: AI API data controls
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: Retention varies by API feature and account controls; default abuse-monitoring retention can be up to 30 days.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Do not describe store:false as blanket zero retention. Minimize submitted customer data and verify account policy.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: External cron heartbeat
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: Healthchecks.io alerts when expected scheduled-job pings stop arriving.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: An independent monitor can detect a stopped scheduler; it still needs an alert-delivery test and an owner.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Portal updates and email disconnected
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: An October 18, 2026 poster asks for contact access records, email notification and linked conversation history after portal updates go unnoticed.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Unverified account-level experience, not a comprehensive current Asana product audit or prevalence estimate.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Automation upkeep exceeded expectation
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: A poster reports 7–9 monthly hours maintaining three workflows after budgeting roughly two hours.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: One unverified report; do not use as an industry benchmark or forecast.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Inactive workflow discovered by customer
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: A poster says lead synchronization stopped for three days after a workflow became inactive, with the customer reporting it first.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Unverified story; motivates an external heartbeat and outcome check rather than a measured failure rate.

v3OfficialAndUX.title: Resend plan and sending limits
v3OfficialAndUX.finding: The plan comparison distinguishes a daily free-tier sending limit and paid usage. Sending and receiving consume transactional allowance.
v3OfficialAndUX.caveat: Retain the existing account where suitable. Reconfirm the exact plan quote; V3 does not treat a placeholder email budget as a verified total.
